_help.about: Trinkets: an active item you use with F (or by tapping the trinket in the bottom left). You carry one at a time. Every character starts with its own (characters.json "trinket"); more are won from dungeon bosses (stages.json dungeon) and swapped at the workbench. Start an id with _ to disable it.
_help.name / desc / icon: Shown on the HUD, in the workbench and in tooltips. Icon names: bible, lantern, bloodlust, pocketwatch, scarecrow, fireflies, voodoo, dinnerbell, venomvial, anatheart, or any icon listed in upgrades.json.
_help.cooldown: Seconds before it can be used again. The trinketCdr stat (affixes, the Well-Oiled Gears blessing) makes it recover faster, and the Busy Paws talent shortens it with kills.
_help.effect: What it does: {"id": ..., plus any numbers to override}. Effects and their numbers: theMoment (buff = buff id from status_effects.json; while it lasts every hit adds a stack of holy fire worth burn x the hit per second (holy fire itself, its spreading circle and its explosions: status_effects.json dots.holy); every holy fire you inflicted with a hit in the last recent seconds heals you regenPerBurn health per second, up to regenCap), holyGround (radius, duration; burns monsters in it for burn = share of your max health per second and sets them on holy fire, and heals you regen health per second while you stand in it), buff (buff = buff id from status_effects.json), timeStop (radius; monsters in it are frozen for duration seconds, bosses for bossDuration, and shocked for shock (0.5 = +50% damage taken) while frozen; enemy shots stop in the air; buff = a buff id you get for the duration), decoy (range, duration; monsters within range chase the scarecrow instead of you, then it explodes for power x your max health in radius as elemental damage; every monster the blast kills adds perKill x your hit damage as extra elemental damage on your weapon hits, up to cap, for emberDuration seconds), fireflies (count, duration, damage = share of your hit damage dealt as elemental damage, every = seconds between zaps, range, shock = every zap shocks for this much), voodoo (radius = how far from you it looks for the monster with the most health; loss = share of that monster's health it loses over duration seconds; grip = meters around it within which tentacles grab every other monster, dealing each the same damage; curse damage is physical and nothing raises or lowers it), dinnerBell (radius, stun, push; also pulls every crystal and essence on the map to you), venom (mult = how much stronger every active poison gets, duration, radius = how far poisoned monsters spread their poisons, every half second, while it lasts), bloodBurst (every monster bleeding from your hits bursts, one after another: it dies at once and sprays its blood over everything within radius meters for share x its max health as physical damage that cannot cause bleeding; bosses and named monsters (cultists, cauldrons, ritualists, tentacles) don't die: the rest of their bleed hits them at once, bossMult times over, and their spray deals half of that).
_help.tags: Tags shown in the Book of Knowledge and tooltips (data.js G.TAGS: physical, poison, elemental, hit, dot, holy, explosion, lightning, shock, control, buff, heal, area, curse...).

bible.name: The Bible
bible.desc: Grants The Moment for 8 seconds: your attacks set monsters on holy fire, and every holy fire you inflicted in the last 4 seconds heals you 3 health per second (up to 36).

lantern.name: Holy Lantern
lantern.desc: Sets the ground below you burning with holy fire for 8 seconds. Monsters in it burn for 50% of your max health per second and catch holy fire; you regenerate 5 health per second while you stand in it.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.desc: Bloodlust: +300% attack speed for 40 seconds, and every monster you kill heals 1% of your max health.

pocketwatch.name: Grandpa's Pocket Watch
pocketwatch.desc: Stops time around you: every monster within 18 meters freezes for 4 seconds (bosses for 2) and is shocked for 50% while it is frozen, their shots hang in the air, and you move 50% faster while the freeze lasts.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow Effigy
scarecrow.desc: Plants a scarecrow. For 8 seconds every monster within 20 meters chases it instead of you, then it explodes for 1000% of your max health as elemental damage. For 30 seconds after, every monster the blast killed adds 5% of your weapon hits as extra elemental damage (up to 150%).

fireflies.name: Jar of Fireflies
fireflies.desc: Releases 12 fireflies that circle you for 20 seconds, each zapping a nearby monster for 40% of your hit damage as elemental damage twice a second. Every zap shocks for 40% (monsters take 40% more damage from everything).

voodoo.name: Voodoo Doll
voodoo.desc: Curses the monster with the most health within 6 meters of you: it loses 50% of its health over 3 seconds, and its tentacles grip every other monster within 3 meters of it, dealing each of them the same damage. Nothing raises or lowers curse damage.

venom.name: Vile Vial of Volatile Venom
venom.desc: Uncorks a cloud of venom: every poison already on a monster becomes three times as strong, and for 8 seconds every poisoned monster spreads all of its poisons to the monsters within 2 meters of it.

dinnerbell.name: Dinner Bell
dinnerbell.desc: Rings for supper: every crystal and essence on the map flies to you, and monsters within 9 meters are blasted back and stunned for 2 seconds.

telltale.name: The Tell-Tale Heart
telltale.desc: It beats louder and louder. Squeeze it, and every monster bleeding from your wounds bursts like an overripe tick: it dies at once and sprays its blood over everything within 2.5 meters for 30% of its max health. Bosses and named monsters don't burst: the rest of their bleed hits them at once, three times over.
